title: P-53 Mutation GA-SOM Analysis
description: Combines genetic algorithms simulating <inode id="mitosis-tree">mitotic propagation</inode> with self-organizing map clustering to identify <inode id="high-risk-pentamers">six pentamer motifs</inode> that consistently precede malignant P-53 mutations.

branches.label: Data & Mitosis Simulation

nodes.title: NCBI Strand Curation
nodes.description: 25 wild-type and cancerous P-53 DNA strands of 2,509 bases each were pulled from NCBI, stripped of non-nucleotide characters, and aligned into parental/pathological pairs.

nodes.title: Generative Mitosis Tree
nodes.description: A binary tree models mitotic bifurcation across 14 generations, with each node storing its generation index, DNA composition, and malignancy state to emulate tumour initiation depth.

branches.description: Builds the raw dataset and simulates <inode id="mitosis-tree">generational DNA drift</inode> from healthy to cancerous P-53 sequences.

branches.label: Path Scoring & Feature Encoding

nodes.title: Levenshtein Drift Scoring
nodes.description: Depth-first traversal of the <inode id="mitosis-tree">generative mitosis tree</inode> extracts generational paths and scores mismatch rates via Levenshtein similarity, flagging the highest-drift ancestors that precede malignant nodes.

nodes.title: k-mer Feature Vectors
nodes.description: Using k = 4 (from log base 4 of sequence length), each strand is transformed into a 1x1024 nucleotide-frequency vector, yielding 73,475 length-adjusted rows.

branches.description: Turns the <inode id="mitosis-tree">mitosis tree</inode> into quantitative mutation drift scores and <inode id="kmer-vectors">fixed-length feature vectors</inode> for clustering.

branches.label: SOM Clustering & Motif Discovery

nodes.title: 1x6 Lattice Selection
nodes.description: SOM grids from 1x2 to 1x11 were compared against the <inode id="kmer-vectors">k-mer frequency vectors</inode>, with correlation analysis reducing redundancy before settling on a 1x6 lattice that reached the best 0.451 silhouette score.

nodes.title: Six High-Risk Pentamers
nodes.description: The winning lattice separated six thymine-heavy pentamer motifs (cagcc, agcca, cccag, ccagg, ttttt, ctttt) that consistently appear in malignant branches.

nodes.title: Pathway-Dependent Progression
nodes.description: Each of the six clusters carries a distinct nucleotide fingerprint, indicating that mutation progression toward malignancy follows structured pathways rather than random drift.

branches.description: Clusters the <inode id="kmer-vectors">encoded strands</inode> to surface the <inode id="high-risk-pentamers">mutation motifs</inode> that mark the transition toward malignancy.
